_status: DRAFT by Text Bot, Oct 30 2026. Not approved by Gary. Same shape as batch 2/3.

r9_smfp_haymaker.name: Bodil
pages:
I stack hay up here where the
goats can't reach. Battle?
battle_won:
Your team's in a haze.
Go rest in the shade.
after:
Hop down the ledge
to the field.

pages: A tiny scarecrow.

It's scaring one very small crow,
who doesn't care.

r9_smfp_cloverpicker.name: Elin
pages:
Four-leaf clovers only grow here.
I counted. Battle?
battle_won:
Luck's on my side today.
Try again tomorrow.
after:
Ledge down, then follow
the strip east.

pages: A clover as big as a plate.

It has five leaves.
Someone glued one on.

r9_smfp_beekeeper.name: Torvald
pages:
Shh. The bees are asleep.
Battle quietly.
battle_won:
Quiet win for me.
The bees didn't even stir.

pages: A hive in the rock wall. It hums.
It's humming the Sunmeadow song.

r9_aurp_vaultkeeper.name: Hedda
pages:
This vault held the city gate keys.
Now it holds me. Battle?
battle_lost: Fine. The keys are gone anyway.
battle_won:
Locked out. Rest your team
and try the door again.
after:
Hop down the ledge
to Ring Street.

pages: A key ring as big as a wheel.
Not one key fits anything.

r9_aurp_signaller.name: Jory
pages:
I wave the lamp when a train comes.
None has in years. Battle?
battle_won:
Red light. Stop and rest
before you go on.
r9_aurp_signaller._name_note: Renamed from Pell: Pell is the Cairnfold digger.

pages: A signal lamp stuck on green.
It's been green for nine years.

r9_aurp_porter.name: Ansel
pages:
Last stop! Well, the stop
after the last stop. Battle?
battle_won:
End of the line for your team.
Mind the gap on the way out.
after:
Drop off the platform edge
and go west.

pages: A platform clock.

Both hands point at
the snack stand.

r9_rep_ridgewalker.name: Edvin
pages:
Nobody walks the ridge but me.
Until now. Battle?
battle_lost: You walk it better than me.
battle_won:
The ridge is still mine.
Come back steadier.
after:
Hop down the ledge
to the field.

pages: A cairn of flat stones.

The top one has a face drawn on.
It looks worried.

r9_rep_denkeeper.name: Saga
pages:
This den is mine.
The rent is one battle.
battle_won:
Rent's overdue. Rest up
and come pay again.
after:
The ledge drops you
by the path.

pages: A chair carved out of the rock.
Very comfy. For a rock.

r9_rep_nookie.name: Liv
pages:
You found my nook!
Nobody finds my nook.
battle_won: Still my nook. Out you go!
after: Ledge down to the west field.

pages: A kite wedged in the rock.

The string goes up and up
and never comes down.

r9_rrp_bellkeeper.name: Halvard
pages:
The old bell hung up here once.
Now I do. Battle?
battle_won:
Saved by the bell. Mine.
Rest your team.
after:
Hop down the ledge
to the field.

pages: A bell-shaped dent in the rock.

Someone drew a little ringer
inside it. Ding.

r9_rrp_herbalist.name: Maja
pages:
I grow moss up here. Very slowly.
Battle while we wait?
battle_lost: The moss grew a bit. You won.
battle_won:
Slow and steady. I win.
Grow a little and come back.
r9_rrp_herbalist._name_note: Renamed from Wren: Wren is the Old Riverbed dowser.

pages: Moss in the shape of a heart.
A tiny sign: TEN YEARS. WORTH IT.

r9_rrp_larkwatcher.name: Ingrid
pages:
The larks nest on this ledge.
Quiet, please. Then battle.
battle_won:
Even the larks won't sing
for that. Rest up.

pages: A nest full of bright pebbles.

One is a button, one is a coin,
and one is a pebble.
